notes: Fastest farmer and elite split-pusher who burns mana and punishes mana-reliant heroes with Mana Void. He needs space and a team that can stall. He is weak early and to lockdown that stops Blink (Axe Call, Duel, Rupture, Chrono, Doom).

Blink into Berserker's Call is one of the best initiations in the game, and Counter Helix shreds illusion and summon heroes. Axe is a strong lane bully who falls off late. Ranged harass kites him, and saves like False Promise undo his engages.

Fiend's Grip is a long single-target disable that pierces spell immunity, so it locks down a BKB carry. Nightmare adds pick and save utility. Grip is a channel, so it can be interrupted, and Counterspell or Rubick can reflect or steal it.

Snowbally skirmisher whose Thirst hunts low-HP heroes and whose Rupture punishes blink and mobility heroes. He pairs well with forced movement (Lasso, Swap, Skewer). He falls off late and struggles against Reincarnation, saves and sustained right-click.

strongVs.note: Frostbite and Crystal Nova catch the immobile Sniper
AoE slows and Freezing Field punish illusions

notes: Lane-strong support with a root, AoE slows and team mana regen (Arcane Aura). Freezing Field is devastating behind big AoE lockdown. Very slow and fragile, so she is easily caught by gap-closers and invisible gankers.
Ranged mid-game carry with elite right-click DPS and Multishot, strong for fast tower-push lineups. Very immobile, so she needs peel and frontline and is punished hard by gap-closers and divers.

Top teamfight initiator with Fissure zoning and a Blink Echo Slam that scales with the number of enemy units, which makes him the go-to answer to illusion and summon heroes. He needs Blink timing, and Rubick stealing Echo is a real threat.

Reliable carry with a strong lane (Blade Fury spell immunity), Healing Ward sustain and split-push. Omnislash deletes isolated squishies but is wasted on illusions, and he loses straight duels to Troll-style right-clickers.

Mirana was the most-picked support of the 7.41 pro meta, mostly at pos4 and also pos5. Sacred Arrow gives long-range picks, and Moonlight Shadow sets up team-wide invisible engages or escapes. She was nerfed in 7.41f and is fragile, and true sight (Haze, Track, Gem) counters Moonlight.

High-skill scaling carry whose Waveform and Attribute Shift make him slippery and hard to burst, while Morph lets him borrow an enemy hero's basic abilities. Io Tether is his classic enabler. Silences, Doom and mana burn shut him down.

Farm-hungry core with fast Raze waveclear, an armor-reduction aura and Requiem teamfight burst. Pros play him mostly as pos1. He was nerfed in 7.41f and has no escape, so he is vulnerable to catch and lane bullies like Viper.

Illusion army carry who spreads damage, burns mana with Diffusal and escapes with Doppelganger, which makes him strong against single-target heroes. AoE hard-counters him: Counter Helix, Echo Slam, cleave, Timbersaw and Bristleback quills.

Elusive tempo mid with Dream Coil initiation, Waning Rift silence and top-tier mobility (Orb, Phase Shift). Punishes blink heroes, but silences and lockdown (Last Word, Crippling Fear, Doom) kill him.

Roaming pick-off hero whose Meat Hook and Dismember isolate immobile targets, and he gets tankier with Flesh Heap and Meat Shield. He relies on hook accuracy and vision. He loses to %max-HP damage (Lifestealer, Ursa) and kiting.

Lane-dominant, easy-to-play core whose Static Link drains right-click carries' damage while Eye of the Storm pushes towers fast. He is strong in the early and mid game but weak to kiting, magic burst and heal-denying sustain like Necrophos.

AoE initiator played mostly mid in pro, with a Burrowstrike stun, a Blink Epicenter that wrecks illusions and clumped teams, good waveclear and a Sand Storm escape. Epicenter now has only a cast point instead of a channel. He falls off late.
Mana-fuelled Ball Lightning diver who picks off backliners and scales into a slippery late-game threat. Hard-countered by mana burn (Anti-Mage), Rupture, silences, and Nyx.

Cleave carry with an AoE Storm Hammer stun and huge God's Strength damage, great vs illusion and summon lineups. Combos with Empower, Tether and Swap. Kited or neutered by evasion, disarm/ethereal and Winter's Curse.

Avalanche and Toss together stun and burst down squishy heroes. Tiny is flexible between a tree-grab right-click carry (common pro pos1), a burst mid and a roaming support. He has the classic Io tether-toss combo. His attack is slow, and he struggles when kited.

strongVs.note: Nether Swap pulls an ally out of Chronosphere
Point-target Magic Missile stops Waveform escapes

notes: Aggressive lane support with a Magic Missile stun, armor-reducing Wave of Terror and a damage aura for ranged pushes. Nether Swap pulls an enemy into the team or saves an ally. She is also an occasional pro carry. She is fragile and needs vision to use Swap well.

Flexible core or support whose Shackleshot is a long stun that pairs with trees or units, while Windrun evasion blanks right-click carries and Focus Fire gives her carry damage. She is vulnerable to magic burst and silences.

Zeus has spammable magic nukes and a global Thundergod's Wrath. His true sight reveals invisible heroes, and Static Field chunks high-HP targets. He has no escape beyond Heavenly Jump, so he is a prime target for divers and magic-resistant cores.

Tanky teamfighter with Tidebringer cleave, Torrent and X Marks combos, and Ghost Ship for AoE stun and damage delay. He is strong in mid-game fights, but ranged mid lanes and magic-immune right-clickers give him trouble.

Lina was heavily contested at TI 2026 and nerfed in 7.41f. Her elite magic burst (LSA, Laguna) and Fiery Soul right-click let her play mid, carry or support. She is squishy and immobile, so she needs protection from divers and Anti-Mage's Counterspell.

Lion has two disables (Hex, Earth Spike) and Finger of Death for easy pick-offs, and Mana Drain instantly kills illusions. He is very fragile and falls off late, so he relies on Blink positioning and on setting up his cores.

Shadow Shaman has the best single-target lockdown (Hex into Shackles) and Mass Serpent Wards that take towers in seconds. He is great for early push lineups. Shackles is a channel, and he is fragile to gap-closers.

Initiator who uses Guardian Sprint into Slithereen Crush, and whose Corrosive Haze gives huge armor reduction and true sight, which makes him a hard counter to invisible heroes. He falls off late, and ranged lanes kite him.

Durable frontliner whose Blink Ravage is one of the best AoE teamfight engages, and Kraken Shell shrugs off harass. Pair him with AoE follow-up. Rubick stealing Ravage, and break or pure damage, are his main problems.

Teamfight support with a bouncing Paralyzing Cask, heals, Maledict, and a Death Ward that shreds anything held in place by Chrono, Black Hole or Call. The Ward is a channel, so stuns, silences and divers answer it.
Lane-dominant support with Frost Shield and Sinister Gaze for peel, and Chain Frost for teamfight damage. Strong early and reliable throughout, but low mobility makes him a target for divers.
Permanently invisible ganker whose Blink Strike, Smoke Screen silence and Backstab burst delete isolated supports. True sight (Haze, Zeus, Track, Gem) and AoE hard-counter him.

Blink Black Hole is one of the strongest AoE lockdowns in the game and pierces spell immunity. Enigma is a strong pro offlaner in 7.41 and needs AoE follow-up (Death Ward, Freezing Field, Requiem). Global Silence and Rubick punish it.
Rearm-based burst and split-push mid who controls the map with March of the Machines, Deploy Turrets and Boots of Travel. Punished hard by gap-closers, global heroes and mana burn.
Sniper brings extreme-range right-click poke and high-ground siege with Shrapnel and Assassinate. He needs a frontline and peel, and any gap-closer or invisible ganker kills him.

Sustain-heavy flex core (Death Pulse heals, Heartstopper aura, Ghost Shroud) whose Reaper's Scythe executes and delays buyback. He eats strength heroes and physical melee. Anti-heal (Ice Blast), silences and mana burn counter him.
Teamfight support with Fatal Bonds, heals, Upheaval and a Chaotic Offering AoE stun that drops a Golem for frontline. He is strong in clumped fights, but slow and fragile against divers.

weakVs.note: Shallow Grave and heals undo Primal Roar pick-offs

notes: Pro offlaner with early pressure from Razorback and rooting Raptors, plus Primal Roar, a spell-immunity-piercing single-target disable for picks. Wants to end early before fights turn into big AoE brawls.
Tempo mid with short-cooldown Blink and AoE magic burst (Scream, Sonic Wave) who dives supports and rotates early. Falls off late. Silences and Rupture shut her down.
Lane-bullying poison support/offlaner with slows, Plague Wards for vision and push, and a Noxious Plague that punishes clumped teams. Falls off late and has no escape.

Late-game carry whose Chronosphere (default ult again since 7.41 removed facets) wins fights and pins mobile heroes. Pairs with ranged AoE damage that works inside Chrono. Rubick stealing Chrono is a disaster.

strongVs.note: Burst like Finger of Death is wasted on Reincarnation

notes: Simple, tanky right-click carry with lifesteal, a stun, Bone Guard skeletons and Reincarnation (no mana cost at max level). Strong in pubs, rarely picked in pro. Anti-heal, kiting and early mana burn (Reincarnation still costs mana at levels 1-2) are his weaknesses.
Top tower-pusher whose Exorcism spirits siege buildings, while Spirit Siphon and Silence help her skirmish. She wants to force fights at towers early to mid game and falls off if the game drags.

Crit-burst assassin carry whose Phantom Strike and Blur let her jump squishy targets. Evasion blanks many physical cores. Armor, pure or magic damage (Helix, Timbersaw), ethereal and kiting counter her.
